senses.gloss: pl. constr. לַגְלוֹגֵי, לִיגְ׳, only in ל׳ חרדל stems of the mustard plant.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 18a:15">B. Bath. 18ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:7">25ᵇ</cite> <he>אוכלות ל׳ חרדליי</he> they (the bees) eat the stems of my mustard plants, v. <cite ref="H01603"><he>חַרְדָּל</he></cite>.
